hooks.text: 近战不靠贴身互撞，而是通过移动站位躲开慢速攻击，再寻找反击位置。
hooks.excerpt: Melee combat focuses a lot on positioning and movement, it's not the typical bump into enemy until it dies. Dodging attacks Most of the enemy attacks are slow and you can usually dodge them by simply walking away:
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 短剑依靠机动单点，巨斧和戟则以慢速范围攻击要求提前站好位置。
hooks.excerpt: Each type of weapon requires a different strategy in combat, for example with short swords you are extremely mobile and can land quick hits on single targets, while dodging enemy strikes, with big weapons such as great axes or halberds, you usually want to position well and attack multiple enemies at once, because your attacks, while powerful, are slow.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 角色由携带物品定义，一百二十余种戒指与护符在有限槽位中决定武器强化方向。
hooks.excerpt: Your character is completely defined by the items he carries. You can empower your weapons by selecting which rings you want to wear, their effects are unique and usually it's not obvious which ring will suit best for your current build, below are a few ring types you can find: Right now there are over 120 ring and amulet types possible to be found. Your character has 4 ring fingers and 2 amulet slots.
